name: Jev Chat Assistant Keyboard for iOS
description: iOS custom-keyboard chat copilot: copy a message in any chat app, tap Analyze on the Jev keyboard, and it calls TypeSafe Jev (systemone) for an 8-way intent Choice and 0-9 risk Score, drafts 2 replies per tone (12 tones) via OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints, re-ranks with Jev, and inserts the pick — never sends.
